answer_1.quote: The second goal, idea verbalization, is carried out after idea exploration to generate fluent and reasonable texts describing an idea... We fine-tune the T5 model to find the optimal parameters θ * to encode the input sequence and verbalize it into an idea sequence...
answer_1.outputs: fluent and reasonable texts describing an idea

answer_2.quote: we use BLEU, METEOR, and ROUGE_L to measure the fluency and topic relevance of the generated ideas.

answer_4.quote: we recruited more domain experts and non-experts in the field of computer science, geo-science (geology and geography), and medicine to conduct the Turing test... Participants are asked to read the machine-generated outputs and human-written texts and choose the real human-written text from a set of N-1 fake ones.
answer_4.guideline: Participants choose the real human-written text from machine-generated outputs.
